location.sheet_or_section: rows US-CAV6-002, US-FEDV6-042, US-CAV6-008, US-FLV6-001 (also US-FLV6-002, US-NYV6-004)

findings.problem: The gap merge gave 74 rows a default effective_from of 2026-01-01 with the note 'in force for the whole build year'. In a sample of 25 checked against the saved copies, 4 are wrong. US-CAV6-002 carries the 2027 SDI rate 1.4% (CA/edd-tax-rated.txt: 'The SDI withholding rate for 2027 is 1.4 percent'). US-FEDV6-042 is a PROPOSED regulation published 2026-09-08 (IRB 2026-37), so it is not in force. US-CAV6-008 records a bill that died on 2026-01-31, so nothing is in force. US-FLV6-001 is FL RT XML version 2026_1.0, dated 2026-09-28 (FL/RT_changes_2026-summary.txt). The saved copies do not support 2 more: US-FLV6-002 (ch. 2026-52 amendment; the copy shows only the history line) and US-NYV6-004 (IT-225-I is the TY2025 edition). Result: 4 wrong + 2 unsupported = 6 of 25 (24%). The other 19 are correct for 2026 but drop an earlier date that the saved copy shows (e.g. US-CAV6-009 DE 8300 Rev. 12 (7-24); US-NYV6-005 revision 2024-03-15; US-ILV6-001 text of P.A. 104-468 eff. 6-16-26; US-TXV6B-001 amended eff. 2025-05-27; US-OHV6-001 9,000 from 2020-01-01).
findings.expected: US-CAV6-002: effective_from 2027-01-01, or split it into a 2026 row (1.3%) and a 2027 row (1.4%). US-FEDV6-042: status 'proposed', with no 'in force' note and the publication date 2026-09-08. US-CAV6-008: status 'not enacted', dated 2026-01-31. US-FLV6-001: effective_from 2026-09-28. US-FLV6-002 and US-NYV6-004: the date the source shows, or a stated limitation. Then re-check the 49 rows not sampled the same way.

location.cell_or_line: paragraph 'Method II exact calculation, New York State [US-NYV7-001]' (line ~9607)

findings.problem: NY.2 says quarterly and semiannual payrolls 'have no Method II table in the publication and are not derived (documented limitation)'. The same paragraph quotes the publication's own conversion rule ('Other periods: convert via a factor ... (p.23)'). NYS-50-T-NYS (1/26) p.23 'Conversion of Tables' gives the official method, including the quarterly case: 'B. Using the monthly table for quarterly payrolls ... factor of 3 ... Multiply the monthly withholding amount by 3' (saved nys50t-nys-1-26.txt lines 1818-1848). The stated limitation therefore contradicts a source already on disk. The change-log rows repeat 'no published table'. This is RQ-598; it is not failed on its own, but the source that closes it is already saved.
findings.expected: Close RQ-598 from p.23: quarterly = monthly table result x 3; semiannual by the general rule A (monthly x 6); NYC the same way. Then reword NY.2 and the change-log rows.

The GA and TX changes exist only in US-UI-001.
findings.expected: In the 19 workbooks: 'Package version 1.1; issue date 2026-11-06; no content change in this specification.' In US-UI-001: keep the GA/TX text and add the Population Rules renumbering (rows 45-52).
